verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine. Its evidence shows on-device apps and a server bound to 127.0.0.1, but nothing states that user data is excluded from model training, nor is there any opt-out or privacy policy. Local execution is an adjacent architectural trait, not a documented capability for this story, and the LoRA distillation training it mentions is unrelated to user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
